description: Manages information related to system users, including retrieving current user details and searching users by email.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserData
endpoints.description: Retrieves the profile and associated data for the currently authenticated user. This endpoint provides details specific to the user making the request.
example_uses: How can I get my own user profile?
Show me the details of the user who is currently logged in.
What is my current user ID and role?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the AI agent needs to access information about the user currently interacting with the system, such as their ID, name, or permissions, without needing to specify any user identifiers.

endpoints.name: GetUserByEmail
endpoints.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific user by providing their email address. This is useful for looking up user profiles when the email is known.

email.description: The email address of the user to retrieve.

example_uses: Find the user whose email is 'john.doe@example.com'.
Can you get me the details for the user with email 'jane.smith@company.org'?
I need to look up a user by their email address.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the AI agent needs to fetch specific user data and the user's email address is available as a search criterion. It's suitable for targeted lookups rather than broad searches.
